ratifiedRule.statement: A member-wanted post's decide-by derives from a DURATION, not a date: publication + 90 days.

optionsRefused.A: Ask for a real date on the ad — refused: adds a required field to the post type least able to bear it, and a band seeking a bassist has no honest value to put in it.
optionsRefused.C: Exempt member-wanted from D-16 — refused: reopens every bound D-16 closed (hold resolve-by ceiling, dormant denominator, auto-close).

ratifiedRule.ninetyDaysProvenance: Ratified as a LIFECYCLE INPUT in 04.01.01 D-16 and 04.06 D-05. NOT inherited from 04.02.01's board half-life. 04.02.01 D-06 stands unchanged — board windows remain presentation only, never a lifecycle transition. The two 90s are separate numbers that coincide by ratification; tuning one at /create-prd does not move the other.
ratifiedRule.d16Universality: Unchanged. Every post has a decide-by; no type can publish without one. Member wanted is an exception to the DERIVATION RULE, never to the field. Taxonomy arithmetic restated as 9 date-derived + 1 duration-derived + 2 asked = 12.
ratifiedRule.acceptedCost: An unfilled member-wanted ad auto-closes at 90 days on a timer the poster never chose. Recorded explicitly in 04.01.01 D-16, 04.06 D-05, 04.06 Edge Cases, and 04.04.01's cross-cut note.
ratifiedRule.tunable: Yes — at /create-prd, on the same footing as 04.01.01 D-13's intervals.

idsAllocated.note: Next free after D-04; checked before allocation. No new Q ids were needed.

questionsClosedOrNarrowed.resolution: Owner ratified option (b). Question struck through; resolution carried in the last column per this tree's convention.

Its member-wanted premise ('a 90-day recency curve') conflated the board half-life with a lifecycle bound and is now a ratified lifecycle value with an exact 90-day exposure ceiling. What remains open is the deadline-bearing case — briefs and open calls whose asked decide-by sits months out — which the ratification did not touch.
